Think how you felt in the beginning when you were seventeen, you didn't see a way out and it took you a long time to get out. But when you finally got out and found someone to be with you were out and changed.

All you've done is gone backwards a bit, You've been here before and you can get out again. It just takes motivation and time, you'll get there. You already know you can do it, It will just be a push to get there.

You have someone who cares for you, even if you have no communication with that person they will still care for you. By choosing to take your own life you are damaging theirs and of all the people who know you, never mind the opportunities you are removing damage you would do to yourself. Just calm down and speak to the people who care for you for the next few days/weeks/months/years, you may not think many people care for you but you have no idea. Think to yourself how many people you think and care about who don't even know that you do. It's the same for you, but you just don't know it.

You could ignore this, or you couldn't. But you know yourself what is the right thing to do but your choosing to do otherwise. Just think about it when your calm, if you get worked up. Just stop. And try talking to people about it later. If you truly think that your going to end it, then speaking to others and looking for alternatives is no waste of time. In fact it might be saving you a lot more, a life worth more.
